headline: AngloGold Ashanti Completes Strategic Investment in Thesis Gold & Silver
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has finalized a strategic investment in Thesis Gold & Silver as part of a C$44 million financing round.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Presents 30th Annual Daffodil Ball for Cancer Research
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals served as the presenting sponsor for the 30th annual Daffodil Ball, which raised $6.76 million to support gold-based cancer research.

headline: Franco-Nevada Participates in Tintina Mines Private Placement
summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation has joined as a cornerstone investor in a C$91 million private placement by Tintina Mines Limited to advance the Domeyko copper-gold project.

headline: Awalé Resources Reports High-Grade Gold Intercepts at Newmont-Funded Odienné Project
summary: Awalé Resources announced new high-grade gold intercepts at the Charger 2 deposit within the Odienné Project, which is being explored under a joint venture funded by Newmont Ventures Limited.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Launches Third Annual $1 Million Future of Mining Challenge
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has launched the third iteration of its 'Future of Mining Challenge,' a $1 million initiative focused on mine optimization and reducing environmental land impacts.

headline: Berenberg Identifies Wheaton Precious Metals as Potential Partner for Rio Tinto Silver Stream
summary: Analysts at Berenberg have suggested that Wheaton Precious Metals would be an ideal partner for a potential $1 billion silver streaming transaction involving Rio Tinto's Oyu Tolgoi mine.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Files Technical Report for La Mina Project Preliminary Economic Assessment
summary: GoldMining Inc. has officially filed a NI 43-101 technical report for the updated preliminary economic assessment (PEA) of its La Mina gold-copper project in Colombia.

headline: Newmont Reports 2025 Year-End Mineral Reserves
summary: Newmont Corporation disclosed its gold mineral reserves at 118.2 million attributable ounces for the year ending 2025, down from 134.1 million ounces in 2024 due to asset divestments.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Announces Preliminary Economic Assessment Results for São Jorge Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. released the results of a preliminary economic assessment (PEA) for its São Jorge gold project located in Pará State, Brazil.

headline: Agnico Eagle Engages Thiess for Fosterville Gold Mine Ventilation Upgrade
summary: Agnico Eagle has contracted Thiess to provide raise boring and shaft lining services for a major ventilation upgrade at its Fosterville Gold Mine in Victoria, Australia.

headline: Newmont Receives Shares of LunR Royalties Corp. via Dividend-in-Kind
summary: Newmont Corporation announced that its subsidiary received over 16 million common shares of LunR Royalties Corp. as part of a dividend-in-kind distribution from Lundin Gold Inc.

headline: Barclays Recommends Agnico Eagle Mines Among Gold Stocks for Potential Rebound
summary: Barclays research analysts have identified Agnico Eagle Mines as a recommended stock for investors looking to gain exposure to gold, citing the company as part of a group of mining stocks well-positioned for a potential market rebound.

headline: Franco-Nevada and Sandstorm Gold Defeated in Burkina Faso Court Proceedings
summary: The Commercial Court of Ouagadougou has ruled in favor of Riverstone Karma SA, resulting in the annulment of a gold purchase agreement involving Franco-Nevada.

headline: Franco-Nevada Gold Purchase Agreement Annulled by Burkinabe Court
summary: The Commercial Court of Ouagadougou has ruled in favor of Riverstone Karma SA, nullifying a 2014 gold purchase agreement held by Franco-Nevada Corporation and Sandstorm Gold.

headline: Franco-Nevada Asserts Retention of Rights to Gold from Burkina Faso Mine
summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation has publicly stated that it retains its rights to gold production from the Karma mine in Burkina Faso, following a recent court ruling.

headline: KGL Resources Receives $16 Million First Tranche Payment Under Wheaton Precious Metals Agreement
summary: KGL Resources Limited has received a $16 million payment representing the first tranche of funding under its existing streaming agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals.

headline: Guinea Orders Halt to Raw Gold Exports, Impacting AngloGold Ashanti Subsidiary
summary: The government of Guinea has mandated that all gold must be refined domestically before export, directly affecting AngloGold Ashanti's local unit, Société Aurifère de Guinée.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Named to Corporate Knights' 2026 Best 50 Corporate Citizens in Canada
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has been recognized as one of Canada's top corporate citizens, ranking 13th in the 2026 'Best 50' list by Corporate Knights.

headline: Agnico Eagle Exercises Participation Right in FireFox Gold Private Placement
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited exercised its participation right to acquire 1,825,000 units as part of the final tranche of FireFox Gold Corp.'s non-brokered private placement.

headline: Agnico Eagle Enters Investor Rights Agreement with Goldsky Resources
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has entered into an investor rights agreement with Goldsky Resources Corp. in connection with Goldsky's acquisition of a stake in the Barsele Gold Project.
